verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry or usage tracking is a fair privacy-posture question for a SaaS registrar, but the evidence pack never mentions any telemetry or analytics opt-out control. WHOIS personal-data redaction is a different privacy feature, about public registration records rather than usage tracking, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
